component.name: Pochette
component.summary: Listen to Qobuz, album by album

description.p: Pochette is a native player for Qobuz, built around albums: your library of whole albums, played from the first track to the last.

ul.li: Albums: your saved albums, to search, filter by genre and decade, sort, or play at random
Discover: Qobuz's new releases, press awards and ideal discography, by genre
Listening stats: your top albums, artists and genres, and how much you listened, by month or year
Lyrics that follow the song, looked up on LRCLIB while you show them
Hi-Res streaming, up to what your subscription allows
Media keys and desktop media controls, through MPRIS
Your desktop's accent color, light and dark modes

description.p: Pochette requires a paid Qobuz subscription. It is not certified by Qobuz and not affiliated with Qobuz.

screenshot.caption: Playing an album, in dark mode

ul.li: Pick the audio output from the Now Playing pane
The Albums tab's covers grow and shrink with the window, as Discover's
Covers are never smaller than 175 pixels
Discover's genre filter is at the right, as the Albums tab's
Listening stats, from the main menu: time listened, album plays, top albums, artists and genres, by month, year or all time
Sort albums by when they were last played, or how many times
Album pages show how many times you played them
The genre filter on Discover's See All pages too
The Now Playing button is labelled when the window has room
Leaving a tab, or clicking it again, takes it back to its own page
Fixed: a search bar taking the focus when changing pages

description.p: The Discover tab fills the window: two rows of six albums on a wide screen, down to six rows of two on a narrow one, with covers that grow and shrink with the window.

ul.li: Pick the quality to stream in from the quality badge in Now Playing
The lyrics show over the album's cover, blurred
One button for the sort and its direction in the Albums tab
The genre and decade filters show how many are picked
A clearer icon at small sizes
Fixed: covers staying grey after sorting, filtering or resizing the Now Playing pane
